purpose: Teach: 校正/無条件/専属/協賛/巻頭/研修生/組み込む/見越し

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 校正の質、若い頃、徹底的に鍛えられた。
lines.en: I was rigorously trained in proofreading standards when I was young.
lines.style: Measured, unhurried cadence. A man drawing from deep memory. Slight weight on 「徹底的に」 — the severity of the training still present. Not boastful, matter-of-fact. Eyes slightly distant, fixed on something from decades back.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。無条件の信頼、社員に伝えています。
lines.en: Yes. I make sure that unconditional trust reaches every member of staff.
lines.style: Direct, steady gaze. A manager stating principle clearly — not tentatively. Warmth underneath the formality. The word 「信頼」 lands with quiet conviction. Slight pause before the second clause, as though it matters that it's said aloud.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 専属の人材、大事に育てろ。
lines.en: The talent you develop in-house — nurture them carefully.
lines.style: Advice-giver's lean forward. Quiet intensity. No rush. Each phrase weighted. 「大事に育てろ」 carries paternal instruction. The voice of someone who has seen what happens when you don't.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 協賛企業との絆、長期で築いています。
lines.en: The relationships with our partner companies — I'm building those for the long term.
lines.style: Confident, grounded tone. Not promotional. A statement of deliberate strategy. Steady pacing. Slight emphasis on 「長期」 — the patience of the approach is the point. Nods slightly as he speaks.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 巻頭、創業精神を、いつも忘れるな。
lines.en: The lead — never forget the founding spirit behind it all.
lines.style: Sharper now, more pointed. The instruction lands at the beginning. Voice hardens fractionally on 「忘れるな」 — not harsh, but firm. An elder insisting. The kind of warning that sounds like it's saved people.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。研修生にも、現場の哲学、組み込む方針です。
lines.en: Yes. Even our trainees — the philosophy we live here is woven into their training from the start.
lines.style: Affirmation with depth. Not just agreeing — explaining his approach. Thoughtful pacing, as though he's considered this carefully. Warmth in the voice when mentioning trainees. Conviction on 「組み込む」 — this is deliberate.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 十年先を見越した経営、続けろ。
lines.en: Keep thinking ten years ahead. Keep building that kind of management.
lines.style: Final instruction. Slower, more resonant. The voice of a man passing a baton. Weight on the future-focused vision. Not urgent, but immovable. Slight exhale at the close — the settling of something that matters.
